lines.text: [grand, scheming] The Evil Mirror. Look in, and your evil twin steps out.

The Evil Mirror.

steps out.

lines.text: [warm, sweetly polite] Good morning! I paid the rent. Early.

lines.text: [horrified] You did WHAT? Back in the mirror!

Back in the mirror!

Of course!
